text:
Aisha: Deploybot proposing unpin of runtime-2.17 -> prod in the 02:30 UTC window. Noting a potential binary-compat gap for an opt-in kernel.

deploybot: Proposal: unpin runtime-2.17 -> prod; window=2026-03-30T02:30Z; canary=eu-west-2; prechecks=kv-cache,bin-compat. Reply with :approve: or :hold:.

Tom: Quick heads-up: a few models with tag 'opt-kernel' broke a micro-benchmark in staging due to symbol layout changes. SDK roll that adjusts ABI lands in ~6 hours.

Neil: How many customers? Can we add a lightweight model-tag exception instead of full delay?

Aisha: It's ~6 customers and ~10 models. Proposed minimal risk plan: add an exception to keep opt-kernel models on runtime-2.16 for 24h, run the unpin at 02:30 with 15% rollout for 30m, monitor, then proceed.

deploybot: Suggested exception snippet:
```
route_exceptions:
  - when: request.metadata.model_tags contains "opt-kernel"
    action: keep_runtime
    runtime: runtime-2.16
    ttl: 24h
rollout_phases:
  - pct: 15
    duration: 30m
```

Tom: Add an auto-rollback: error-rate increase >1.3x for 10m -> rollback. Also add p95 latency watch.

sre-bot: Alert created: error-rate >1.3x baseline for 10m OR p95_latency >1.5x baseline for 15m -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases; auto-rollback enabled.

Neil: Sounds reasonable. Please include SDK ticket SDK-2310 in release note so support can track.

Aisha: I'll post release note 20m before and mark this thread :approve: with exception and rollout gating. If alerts fire we rollback.

deploybot: Action queued: unpin runtime-2.17 -> prod at 2026-03-30T02:30Z; rollout=15%; prechecks passed.

Tom: I'll be oncall during the window. End of thread.
